entities.name: Casindral Isle
entities.description: Southernmost island of Corondor, a good harbor for merchant, pleasure and pirate ships and landing point for refugees from Jamuura.

entities.name: Corondor
entities.description: Continent to which the isle belongs.

entities.name: Jamuura
entities.description: Tropical land whose troubles drove refugees to the isle.

events.summary: Refugees from the troubles in Jamuura landed at Casindral Isle.
